OR If Luke or Leia in battle alone, draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. OR If an Alderaan or Tatooine location on table, ▲ Luke (or a Lars) or Leia (or Bail) with printed deploy < 4.”
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image of 1 September 2026<ref name="ht-nh-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/b4f45e2e08125618fe25af7b02e71fa092ea379c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual27-Light/large/anewhope.gif anewhope.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/b4f45e2e08125618fe25af7b02e71fa092ea379c b4f45e2] (1 September 2026).</ref>, no errata mark. * '''PC-E1''' ([[A New Hope (Virtual Set 27) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 27 release sheet<ref name="sheet27-20261013">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (PDF, 6 pages; publisher edition line “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2026”).</ref>, page 5, October 2026 edition: “For remainder of turn, opponent may not cancel battle destiny draws. OR If Luke or Leia in battle alone, draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. OR If an Alderaan or Tatooine location on table, ▲ Luke (or a Lars) or Leia (or Bail) with printed deploy &lt; 4.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[A New Hope (Virtual Set 27)]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[A New Hope (Virtual Set 27)]] (repository revision dated 1 September 2026) as a printable slip under the label “•New Hope”; the printed game text matches the card image.  The sheet's label reads “•New Hope”, not “A New Hope” as the card's title line prints; recorded as printed. '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
